what: final state of the insurance replay: every result directory of OURS that holds a .par was replayed with `sconecmd -e` so a .par.sto exists on disk before the Hyfydy licence expires. SCONE's optimiser writes .par but NOT .par.sto; without this pass a cell that was optimised could never be measured again once the licence lapses.

disk_state_now.run_reported_3_vs_disk_16: the run's own counter said 3 because it only enumerated the cell families it was given. The disk scan at r415 enumerated ALL of our result directories and found 16. The extra 13 are the 10 retired-2D probes plus 3 more of the same x0.00 family. Nothing measurable was missed; the discrepancy is scope, and this deposit records the wider scope.

protected.note: counted, never opened for writing, never killed. The replay wrote only into OUR directories; no protected name appears in the replay list.

VERDICT: COMPLETE, and nothing is at risk from licence expiry. 1113 of 1129 of our result directories hold both a .par and a replayed .par.sto. The 16 without one are 10 retired-2D throwaway probes and the 6 x0.00 dorsiflexor-ablation cells, which CANNOT produce a .sto -- reproduced at r415 with the error 'Error computing fa for gastroc_l; excitation=-nan(ind)' -- and which are already excluded from every claim. Protected set intact at 112, never opened for writing. sconecmd 0.
